items.title: Jon Weber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 2, 2012
items.q: Buddy Clark sang it, an enormous hit

ctx.x: A whole bunch of Lindas. They listen to the song, oh that’s nice, and you can hear a cash register ringing. Lo and behold they did release it and it became a — Buddy Clark sang it, an enormous hit and it was on the hit parade at least two months, it was top of the charts a bunch of that time. Tons of girls named Linda after that. All right fast forward. The girl for whom that song was written, Linda, March 12, 1969 guess what she does?
